name: The Paper Boat Journey on a Starry River
description: A large, elegant paper boat with a glowing lantern inside, sailing peacefully on a magical river made of flowing stars and constellations.
prompt: A large, beautifully folded paper boat carrying a small, warm glowing lantern, sailing on a surreal river of liquid stars and constellations. The river flows through a deep, dark cosmic valley, reflecting the light of the Milky Way and distant nebulae. The scene is peaceful, magical, and symbolic of a quiet journey through the cosmos. High detail, fantasy illustration.
caption: Drifting silently on a river of stars, carrying a single light into the infinite night. ⭐⛵
